Buggy app. 1.	Location Persistence Issue
	•	When the user first sets the location to a serviceable area (e.g., Whitefield), the app works fine.
	•	After moving to a non-serviceable location and using the app, the location gets stuck as non-serviceable.
	2.	Unable to Reset Location
	•	Once back in a serviceable area, the app still picks the previously cached non-serviceable location.
	•	There is no option to reset/change the location inside the application.
	•	Even if the user tries to change the location manually, it still throws an error.
	3.	Location Cache Issue
	•	Even after uninstalling and reinstalling the application, the location seems tied to the mobile number
	•	User is unable to log in with the same mobile number after uninstall/reinstall, as the app continues to pick the unserviceable location from cache/backend.
	4.	Impact
	•	Users stuck in this loop are completely blocked from accessing the app.
	•	No workaround available (changing location, reinstalling, or re-login fails).

Poor Service and Misleading availability of Items on App. I tried placing an order through this app. My first order was fine, but every order after that has been a frustrating experience. About 10 minutes after placing my order, I got a call saying the kachori I ordered wasn’t available. I agreed to replace it with batata vada, which was shown as available in the app. Another 15 minutes later, I received another call saying batata vada was also unavailable. When I asked what was actually available, I was told sandwiches. I agreed to that as well, only to be told the sandwich wasn’t available either.

The app repeatedly shows items as available when they aren’t, which is misleading. Your payment is deducted first, and only afterward do you find out that the items can’t be fulfilled. Until they fix their inventory management, I recommend using COD if possible, or choosing a more reliable alternative like Bistro by Blinkit.
